subject: Legal routing & procurement next steps for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + legal/procurement routing (Acme)

Thanks again for the time today, Samantha — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for customer-facing summarization and ticket triage (prod pilot Q1).
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency < 200ms p95, SOC 2 + documented data retention, and clear unit economics at scale.
- Technical follow-ups: Dev will share perf/throughput guidance for your indexing volumes.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I shared the standard NDA to get legal comfortable — attaching our template for your review (Acme_NDA_v1.pdf). Please confirm the owner for NDA review.
2) Start routing the MSA/DPA to your procurement/legal teams. We typically accept tracked redlines on the MSA; our legal team reviews in sequence: NDA -> MSA -> DPA (if needed).
3) Dev to provide a short perf note and proposed pilot sizing by Friday.

Could you confirm: primary legal contact, procurement timeline, and whether your security team needs a questionnaire (we can send our SOC 2 letter and controls matrix)?

Thanks — I’ll loop in legal here once you confirm owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Attachment: Acme_NDA_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 82 KB)

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme.com>

Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + legal/procurement routing (Acme)

Thanks Marissa — great meeting. Quick answers: 

- NDA owner: Rajiv (Legal) will take the lead on NDA & MSA review (cc’d).
- Procurement timeline: procurement team expects to have initial review and redline request within 7 business days after receiving MSA draft. Final PO timeline depends on pricing approvals.
- Security: yes — send SOC 2 report + controls matrix; our security team will also want a short data flow diagram.

Rajiv — can you confirm if procurement wants the NDA signed before sharing the MSA draft? If so we’ll prioritize that.

Samantha
Director, Product Ops | Acme Corp
samantha.ortiz@acme.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + legal/procurement routing (Acme) — NDA + MSA draft

Rajiv — thanks for stepping in. Attaching our standard MSA draft for your review (Redwood_MSA_DRAFT.docx) along with the NDA we shared earlier. Our suggested sequencing: 

1) NDA signed (if you require) — we can countersign within 1 business day once we receive a countersigned copy.
2) MSA redlines: please send a single redline pass if possible. For efficiency we ask the counterparty to consolidate redlines so our legal team can do a single review cycle.
3) Turn times: typical turnaround for our legal on a single consolidated redline pass is 5-7 business days; if there are extensive commercial changes it can be longer. We can expedite to 2-3 business days for critical enterprise deals with agreement on scope of redlines.

Security artifacts: attaching SOC 2 letter and controls matrix link in case it helps: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Acme-Redwood-Sales

Dev — can you add a short note about expected throughput and latency for our proposed pilot so Rajiv/procurement know sizing assumptions?

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_DRAFT.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 96 KB); Acme_NDA_v1.pdf

From: procurement@acme.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acme.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + legal/procurement routing (Acme) — timeline and next steps

Marissa/Rajiv — we reviewed the MSA draft. A few notes from procurement perspective: 

- Please provide a single clean copy and a single tracked redline on the MSA. Our preference is to receive the redline within 7 business days so we can route internally.
- Procurement requests a standard 7 business day review window; if Redwood requires faster turnaround please indicate escalation contacts.
- For PO processing we’ll need final signed MSA + statement of work and proposed billing/PO details (net30 by default unless otherwise negotiated).

Action items for Redwood to confirm: 
1) Will Redwood accept a single consolidated redline? (Yes/no)
2) Who on Redwood side is the legal contact for escalation?
3) Estimated time to countersign NDA once we return a countersigned copy.

If you can send the consolidated redline and the clean copy today, we’ll start our internal routing.

Procurement Team | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com
